lines.zh: 每一步都把雪踩成硬冰。
lines.en: Every step I take packs the snow into hard ice.

lines.zh: 我这身冰壳，走起来咔咔响。
lines.en: This shell of ice clicks and groans as I walk.

lines.zh: 荒原这么空，我随便走。
lines.en: The waste is empty; I walk wherever I please.

lines.zh: 雪地是我的地盘，慢慢巡。
lines.en: The snowfield is my domain; I patrol it slowly.

lines.zh: 腿是冰柱，弯一下要半天。
lines.en: My legs are ice columns; bending one takes half a day.

lines.zh: 脚印比坑还深，雪埋不住。
lines.en: My footprints are deeper than pits; snow cannot fill them.

lines.zh: 风雪推我，我自己也晃。
lines.en: The blizzard pushes me, and I sway along with it.

lines.zh: 我是这带最顶上的那个。
lines.en: I stand at the very top of this food chain.

lines.zh: 冰碴一路掉，像下小雨。
lines.en: Ice chips fall off me like a light drizzle.

lines.zh: 慢慢挪，反正没人跑得掉。
lines.en: I move slowly; no one here can outrun me anyway.

lines.zh: 树被我膝盖一碰就折。
lines.en: Trees snap at a touch of my knee.

lines.zh: 雪原尽头还是雪原。
lines.en: Past the snowfield there is only more snowfield.

lines.zh: 沉得要命，可我不累。
lines.en: I weigh a fortune, yet I never tire.

lines.zh: 风把我的肩吹出尖角。
lines.en: Wind has carved spikes onto my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我一步踏下去，冻土裂开一道缝。
lines.en: One step, and the frozen ground splits.

lines.zh: 冰从我的脚底往上长，跟着我走。
lines.en: Ice grows up from my soles and walks with me.

lines.zh: 站着不动，我也在结冰。
lines.en: Standing still, I keep freezing thicker.

lines.zh: 风雪里没别的声音，只有我。
lines.en: In the blizzard there is no other sound but me.

lines.zh: 我等雪盖住脚背，再抬脚。
lines.en: I wait for snow to cover my feet, then lift one.

lines.zh: 这么冷的地方，活物真少。
lines.en: In a place this cold, living things are rare.

lines.zh: 冰里冻着一根旧树枝。
lines.en: An old branch is frozen inside my chest.

lines.zh: 我数呼吸，一次要很久。
lines.en: I count my breaths; each one takes a long while.

lines.zh: 远处有狼叫，我不理。
lines.en: A wolf howls far off; I pay it no mind.

lines.zh: 太阳照在冰上，晃得眼疼。
lines.en: Sunlight on my ice stings my eyes.

lines.zh: 我蹲不下来，只好站着歇。
lines.en: I cannot crouch, so I rest standing.

lines.zh: 身上裂了条缝，又会冻上。
lines.en: A crack opens on me and freezes shut again.

lines.zh: 这片荒原归我，安静归我。
lines.en: This waste is mine, and so is the quiet.

lines.zh: 我等一个敢走近的东西。
lines.en: I wait for something brave enough to come close.

lines.zh: 你比我膝盖高一点，够了。
lines.en: You reach a little above my knee; that is enough.

lines.zh: 小人，你是来送热的吗？
lines.en: Little one, have you come to bring me warmth?

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气，我看得清。
lines.en: Your breath hangs white in the cold; I see it.

lines.zh: 别抬头太久，脖子会僵。
lines.en: Do not look up too long; your neck will stiffen.

lines.zh: 你身上有火的味道，怪。
lines.en: You carry the smell of fire; strange.

lines.zh: 我低头，你就像块石子。
lines.en: When I look down, you are a pebble.

lines.zh: 你在雪上踩的小洞，我记住了。
lines.en: I have noted the small holes you punch in the snow.

lines.zh: 想看清我？先退后十步。
lines.en: Want a good look at me? Step back ten paces.

lines.zh: 你眨眼，我的冰脸不会动。
lines.en: You blink; my ice face never moves.

lines.zh: 我认得你这种会跑的东西。
lines.en: I know your kind: the sort that runs.

lines.zh: 疼，可冰不会碎。
lines.en: It hurts, but ice does not shatter.

lines.zh: 你敲下我一层冰壳。
lines.en: You knocked a layer of my shell away.

lines.zh: 这点伤，冻一夜就好。
lines.en: This wound will close after one frozen night.

lines.zh: 我脚下晃了，你要退。
lines.en: My footing shifted; you should back away.

lines.zh: 裂痕很长，但没通到心。
lines.en: The crack runs far, but not to my core.

lines.zh: 你打得动我？有点意思。
lines.en: You can actually hurt me? Interesting.

lines.zh: 冰屑落进雪里，分不清。
lines.en: Ice chips fall into snow; I cannot tell them apart.

lines.zh: 我压下身子，雪都被震起。
lines.en: I lower myself and snow bursts upward.

lines.zh: 再来，我这层壳还厚。
lines.en: Again; my shell is still thick.

lines.zh: 痛感从脚底爬到肩。
lines.en: The ache crawls from my soles to my shoulders.

lines.zh: 吃的？我只吃冷风。
lines.en: Food? Cold wind is all I swallow.

lines.zh: 你把肉举着，它先冻硬了。
lines.en: Hold that meat up and it freezes hard first.

lines.zh: 我没有胃，只有冰。
lines.en: I have no stomach, only ice.

lines.zh: 别拿胡萝卜，它像根冰锥。
lines.en: Skip the carrot; it looks like an ice spike to me.

lines.zh: 香味到我这，都结成霜。
lines.en: Every smell that reaches me turns to frost.

lines.zh: 你喂不饱一座冰山。
lines.en: You cannot feed an iceberg.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候，啃的是雪。
lines.en: When hungry, I chew on snow.

lines.zh: 手里的东西收好，会冻裂。
lines.en: Put that away; the cold will split it.

lines.zh: 你晃食物，我只当风在吹。
lines.en: Wave your food; I take it for wind.

lines.zh: 我这体型，一顿都嫌多。
lines.en: At my size, one meal a day is too much.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像雪球碰山。
lines.en: You strike me like a snowball hitting a mountain.

lines.zh: 我被撞掉一块冰，小事。
lines.en: A chunk of ice chipped off me; no matter.

lines.zh: 别贴太近，我身上零下。
lines.en: Do not press close; I run below zero.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我晃了三下才停。
lines.en: The knock set me swaying three times before I stopped.

lines.zh: 你的护甲蹭过我，结了霜。
lines.en: Your armor scraped me and frosted over.

lines.zh: 我挪开半步，雪都塌了。
lines.en: I shift half a step and the snow collapses.

lines.zh: 撞我你手会粘住，小心。
lines.en: Touch me and your hand sticks; be careful.

lines.zh: 这块冰地太滑，我刹不住。
lines.en: This ice is too slick; I cannot stop.

lines.zh: 你退开，我不想压扁你。
lines.en: Step back; I do not wish to flatten you.

lines.zh: 两座冰山相撞，也没这么响。
lines.en: Two icebergs colliding would not ring like that.

lines.zh: 另一个我，几年才见一次。
lines.en: Another of my kind appears once in years.

lines.zh: 我们不结伴，冰只往下沉。
lines.en: We do not pair up; ice only sinks.

lines.zh: 想找个同样冷的，太难。
lines.en: Finding someone as cold as me is hard.

lines.zh: 同类见面，先比谁更高。
lines.en: When kin meet, we compare heights first.

lines.zh: 冰与冰靠一起，会冻成一块。
lines.en: Ice against ice freezes into one block.

lines.zh: 我这体型，谈这个太费事。
lines.en: At my size, such matters are too much effort.

lines.zh: 雪原广阔，我们各自守着。
lines.en: The snowfield is vast; each of us keeps a part.

lines.zh: 没有小巨人，只有更多雪。
lines.en: No little giants, only more snow.

lines.zh: 我的血脉是千年不化的冰。
lines.en: My blood is ice that has never melted.

lines.zh: 别问了，我连回声都没有。
lines.en: Do not ask; I do not even have an echo.

lines.zh: 这块铁，冻在我掌心。
lines.en: This iron on the ground freezes into my palm.

lines.zh: 我捡东西得用两根手指。
lines.en: I must pick things up with two fingers.

lines.zh: 雪里埋的骨头，我带走。
lines.en: Bones buried in snow, I take along.

lines.zh: 这块石头凉，正合我手。
lines.en: This stone is cool; it suits my hand.

lines.zh: 谁丢的剑？我拿它当牙签。
lines.en: Whose sword is this? I will use it as a toothpick.

lines.zh: 弯腰很慢，捡一次算一次。
lines.en: Bending is slow; each pickup is an event.

lines.zh: 东西到我手里就结霜。
lines.en: Whatever reaches my hand gathers frost.

lines.zh: 我收着，反正没人敢要。
lines.en: I keep it; nobody would dare claim it.

lines.zh: 这袋东西轻得像羽毛。
lines.en: This sack feels as light as a feather.

lines.zh: 我不缺，只是顺手拿走。
lines.en: I lack nothing; I simply take it in passing.

lines.zh: 那个会动的小点，我看见了。
lines.en: That small moving dot; I have seen it.

lines.zh: 荒原上终于有活物。
lines.en: At last, something alive on the waste.

lines.zh: 你踩碎雪壳，出卖了你。
lines.en: The crunch of snow crust under you gave you away.

lines.zh: 目标确定，慢慢转身。
lines.en: Target fixed; I turn slowly toward it.

lines.zh: 我这一拳十点，受得住吗？
lines.en: My fist hits for ten; can you take it?

lines.zh: 跑吧，我从不着急。
lines.en: Run if you like; I am never in a hurry.

lines.zh: 雪地没有遮挡，你无处藏。
lines.en: The snow offers no cover; there is nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我锁定了，冰会跟着你。
lines.en: I have locked on; the ice follows you now.

lines.zh: 这么小的猎物，也值得我动手。
lines.en: Such small prey, and still worth my swing.

lines.zh: 你身上有热气，我追热气。
lines.en: You give off heat; I chase the heat.

lines.zh: 别往坡上跑，我一步就到。
lines.en: Do not run uphill; one step gets me there.

lines.zh: 我记住你的脚印了。
lines.en: Your tracks in the snow are already in my mind.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，眼睛不眨。
lines.en: I keep my ice eyes on you, unblinking.

lines.zh: 你再退，我就再跟一步。
lines.en: Step back again and I follow one more step.

lines.zh: 雪落在你肩，我看得清楚。
lines.en: Snow settles on your shoulder; I see it clearly.

lines.zh: 我的心跳很慢，你的很快。
lines.en: My heart beats slowly; yours races.

lines.zh: 这距离，我一伸手就到。
lines.en: At this distance, one reach covers it.

lines.zh: 你举盾的样子，像块木板。
lines.en: Your raised shield looks like a plank to me.

lines.zh: 别绕圈，我转身要花很久。
lines.en: Do not circle; turning costs me a long while.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，雪雾起来了。
lines.en: I lower myself and snow mist rises.

lines.zh: 你只有一次机会，我知道。
lines.en: You get one chance at this; I know it.

lines.zh: 冰在响，那是要动手了。
lines.en: The ice is creaking; that means I am about to strike.

lines.zh: 我慢慢举起手臂，别慌。
lines.en: I raise my arm slowly; do not panic.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在响，我听得出方位。
lines.en: Your armor rattles; I can hear where you are.

lines.zh: 这一拳下去，雪地凹了个坑。
lines.en: My fist lands and the snowfield gains a crater.

lines.zh: 十点力道，够你退三步。
lines.en: Ten points of force; three steps backward for you.

lines.zh: 我砸偏了，冰屑满天飞。
lines.en: I miss and ice shards scatter everywhere.

lines.zh: 别躲，我动作慢，你躲得掉。
lines.en: Do not dodge; I am slow, you can manage it.

lines.zh: 拳头是整块冰，砸中很闷。
lines.en: My fist is solid ice; it lands with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 你被我扫到，护甲都白了。
lines.en: I clip you and your armor whitens.

lines.zh: 我抬手要三秒，你早跑了？
lines.en: My arm takes three seconds; already gone?

lines.zh: 冰拳落空，砸碎半块岩石。
lines.en: My ice fist misses and shatters half a boulder.

lines.zh: 这一拳不算重，下一拳更沉。
lines.en: That one was light; the next lands heavier.

lines.zh: 命中了，你身上结了薄霜。
lines.en: Hit; a thin frost spreads over you.

lines.zh: 雪地里站起来一个我。
lines.en: Out of the snowfield, one of me rises.

lines.zh: 荒原又多了一座会走的冰山。
lines.en: The waste gains another walking iceberg.

lines.zh: 我从雪堆里挣出来，抖落一地。
lines.en: I tear free of the drift, shedding snow everywhere.

lines.zh: 这一带很久没有巨人了。
lines.en: No giant has stood in this area for a long time.

lines.zh: 五个权重，让我难得出现。
lines.en: A weight of five makes my appearing rare.

lines.zh: 风雪把我磨出来，慢慢成形。
lines.en: The blizzard ground me out and I took shape.

lines.zh: 我从冰层里起身，脚下裂开。
lines.en: I rise from the ice layer; the ground splits.

lines.zh: 头顶是灰天，脚下是白雪。
lines.en: Grey sky above, white snow below.

lines.zh: 这片雪原，今天起有主人了。
lines.en: This snowfield has an owner from today on.

lines.zh: 我刚睁眼，先看看四野。
lines.en: I have just opened my eyes; let me survey the land.

lines.zh: 火烤过来，我身上冒白汽。
lines.en: Fire washes over me and white steam rises.

lines.zh: 从坡上滑下去，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I slide down the slope and punch out a crater.

lines.zh: 水一浸，我的边角就在化。
lines.en: Water soaks in and my edges start to melt.

lines.zh: 炸开我半边身子，冰碴乱飞。
lines.en: Half my body blows apart, ice chips flying.

lines.zh: 箭钉在冰上，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my ice and will not pull free.

lines.zh: 这股魔法在我体内打滑。
lines.en: This magic slides around inside me.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可也在变薄。
lines.en: I eat nothing, yet I am thinning.

lines.zh: 雷劈在冰上，白得刺眼。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my ice, blindingly white.

lines.zh: 那里没有雪原，我站不住脚。
lines.en: No snowfield there; I could not keep my footing.
